description: This file defines a React functional component 'Header' used for rendering the top layout section of a web application. It manages user session display, including sign-in and sign-out functionalities, and presents different UI elements based on the authentication state.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component that renders the header section with session info and login/logout controls.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: async function that logs out the user, refreshes session state, and redirects to login page.
